sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: In the spring of 1985, Bill Mora was wrapping up his high school education
sentences.zh: 1985年春天，比尔·莫尔即将结束高中学业，

sentences.en: and getting ready to move to Poughkeepsie, New York.
sentences.zh: 并准备搬到纽约州波基普西。

sentences.en: Come fall, he'd be starting his freshman year at Vassar College.
sentences.zh: 到了秋天，他将在瓦萨学院开始他的大学一年级。

sentences.en: Like many incoming college students,
sentences.zh: 和许多刚入学的大学生一样，

sentences.en: Bill was concerned about how he would pay for his education.
sentences.zh: 比尔很担心自己该如何支付学费。

sentences.en: My financial aid package in my freshman year
sentences.zh: 我大一时的经济资助方案

sentences.en: was basically a combination of student loans and work study.
sentences.zh: 基本上是学生贷款和勤工俭学的组合。

sentences.en: But at the end of Bill's sophomore year,
sentences.zh: 但在比尔大二结束时，

sentences.en: he received an unexpected letter in the mail.
sentences.zh: 他在邮箱里收到了一封意想不到的信。

sentences.en: I get this letter congratulating me
sentences.zh: 我收到了这封信，祝贺我

sentences.en: for receiving something called the Hager Scholars Award.
sentences.zh: 获得了一项名为“哈格尔学者奖”的荣誉。

sentences.en: And the letter explained that the award would take the place
sentences.zh: 信中解释说，这个奖项将替代

sentences.en: in my financial aid package of my student loan.
sentences.zh: 我经济资助方案中的学生贷款。

sentences.en: And here's what it said.
sentences.zh: 信上是这么写的。

sentences.en: This is an interest-free loan with a moral obligation to repay.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔无息贷款，但有偿还的道德义务。

sentences.en: And I was like, what?
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，什么？

sentences.en: Like, what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 就像是，这是什么意思？

sentences.en: Okay, I will take the money.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这钱我要了。

sentences.en: Like, you know, I think my young self was like,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我年轻的时候就觉得，

sentences.en: I will take the money and I don't have to have a student loan anymore.
sentences.zh: 这钱我收下了，而且我再也不用背负学生贷款了。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: It wasn't that simple, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，事情并没有那么简单。

sentences.en: The phrase moral obligation to repay stuck with Bill.
sentences.zh: “偿还的道德义务”这句话深深印在了比尔的脑海里。

sentences.en: It made him think.
sentences.zh: 这让他陷入了思考。

sentences.en: So, you know, at the time I was like, what is that?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，当时我在想，那是什么？

sentences.en: I don't know what this is.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是什么。

sentences.en: I show it to my mom.
sentences.zh: 我把它拿给我妈妈看。

sentences.en: She's like, yeah, it's just a grant.
sentences.zh: 她说，噢，这只是一笔补助金。

sentences.en: You're fine.
sentences.zh: 你没事。

sentences.en: Just take the money.
sentences.zh: 拿着这钱就行了。

sentences.en: But, you know, I graduated.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我毕业了。

sentences.en: I went to graduate school.
sentences.zh: 我读了研究生。

sentences.en: I became a professor.
sentences.zh: 我成了一名教授。

sentences.en: I paid off all my actual student loans.
sentences.zh: 我还清了所有真正的学生贷款。

sentences.en: And when I had done so, I thought to myself, oh, wait, I'm not done yet.
sentences.zh: 当我做完这一切时，我心想，哦，等等，我还没完呢。

sentences.en: There's that Hager Award.
sentences.zh: 还有那个哈格尔奖。

sentences.en: And so I, like, you know, go online and look it up.
sentences.zh: 所以我就，你知道的，上网去查了一下。

sentences.en: And I'm like, yeah, there it is.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，对，它就在那里。

sentences.en: Like, I have a moral obligation to repay.
sentences.zh: 就像，我负有偿还的道德义务。

sentences.en: I better start repaying this thing.
sentences.zh: 我最好开始把这笔钱还了。

sentences.en: And that letter, that line, that thing about how, you know, you have a moral obligation,
sentences.zh: 而那封信，那行字，关于你知道的你负有道德义务的那句话，

sentences.en: it caught me.
sentences.zh: 它击中了我。

sentences.en: It grabbed me and pulled me right in.
sentences.zh: 它抓住了我，把我整个人拽了进去。

sentences.en: The award made explicit something that's often overlooked in the way we think about money.
sentences.zh: 这个奖项明确表达了一点，而这一点在我们对金钱的看法中往往被忽视了。

sentences.en: At its core, money is about human relationships.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，金钱关乎人与人之间的关系。

sentences.en: And at a macro level, loans and gifts and paychecks and the dollars that come out of
sentences.zh: 从宏观层面来看，贷款、礼物、薪水以及从

sentences.en: ATMs are clues to a culture, even the structure of a nation.
sentences.zh: 自动取款机里吐出来的美元，都是一种文化的线索，甚至是一个国家结构的线索。

sentences.en: I'd like to cash these nickels, and I'll have them in quarters, please.
sentences.zh: 我想把这些五分硬币兑换一下，请给我换成25美分的硬币。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: On a good day, it's about a half a million dollars.
sentences.zh: 在生意好的一天里，大约有五十万美元。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm amazed.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很震惊。

sentences.en: You got a dollar?
sentences.zh: 你有钱吗？

sentences.en: Open your purse.
sentences.zh: 打开你的钱包。

sentences.en: I see it right there.
sentences.zh: 我看到它就在那儿。

sentences.en: Give it.
sentences.zh: 拿出来。

sentences.en: Give me your dollar.
sentences.zh: 把你的钱给我。

sentences.en: You got me.
sentences.zh: 你把我问住了。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: Well, that's right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没错。

sentences.en: I figured you could go out and get yourself whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 我想你可以出去给自己买任何你想要的东西。

sentences.en: Hi, Dad.
sentences.zh: 嗨，爸爸。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: I just wanted to let you know that I'm going to win the million dollars.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让你知道，我要赢得那一百万美元。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we examine the intangible elements of cold, hard cash.
sentences.zh: 本期《隐藏的大脑》节目中，我们将探讨冷冰冰的现金背后那些无形的元素。

sentences.en: Coins and currency are not just tokens of economic value, but markers of emotional connection and
sentences.zh: 硬币和纸币不仅仅是经济价值的符号，它们还是情感连接和

sentences.en: shared history.
sentences.zh: 共同历史的标志。

sentences.en: There's a story we tell about what the world looked like before we invented money.
sentences.zh: 我们流传着这样一个故事：讲述在我们发明货币之前，世界是什么样子的。

sentences.en: It's a story built on the idea of barter.
sentences.zh: 这是一个建立在以物易物概念上的故事。

sentences.en: This is the standard story that we read in the economics textbooks and that has been handed
sentences.zh: 这是我们在经济学教科书中读到的标准故事，自19世纪中期甚至更早以来，它就一直

sentences.en: down to us at least since the mid-19th century, if not before.
sentences.zh: 代代相传。

sentences.en: This, again, is anthropologist Bill Morer, who told us the story of his moral obligation to
sentences.zh: 这位再次接受采访的是人类学家比尔·莫尔，他曾向我们讲述了他偿还学生贷款的

sentences.en: repay that student loan.
sentences.zh: 道德义务的故事。

sentences.en: He's now the dean of the School of Social Sciences at the University of California, Irvine, and
sentences.zh: 他现在是加州大学欧文分校社会科学学院的院长，

sentences.en: he studies the origins and nature of money.
sentences.zh: 他专门研究货币的起源和本质。

sentences.en: And it goes something like this.
sentences.zh: 故事大致是这样的。

sentences.en: In the beginning, before there was money, if I had something that you needed, I would approach
sentences.zh: 最初，在没有货币的时候，如果我有什么东西是你需要的，我就会带着那个东西去找

sentences.en: you with that thing and see if you had anything that I needed.
sentences.zh: 你，看看你有没有什么东西是我需要的。

sentences.en: So if you wanted some fish and you needed some acorns and I had them, I could approach
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你想要一些鱼，而你需要一些橡果，而我正好有，我就可以带着

sentences.en: you with those acorns and we could basically barter on the spot, figuring out how many acorns
sentences.zh: 这些橡果去找你，我们基本上可以当场以物易物，弄清楚多少橡果

sentences.en: equals how many fish.
sentences.zh: 等于多少鱼。

sentences.en: The problem with barter is it really does depend on us each meeting each other's needs in that
sentences.zh: 以物易物的问题在于，它确实取决于我们双方在那个时刻

sentences.en: moment.
sentences.zh: 刚好满足彼此的需求。

sentences.en: And so the origin story of money that we have is that humans invented money essentially to
sentences.zh: 因此，我们听到的货币起源故事是，人类发明货币本质上是为了

sentences.en: be a mediator in these sorts of exchanges.
sentences.zh: 在这些类型的交换中充当调解人。

sentences.en: In other words, if you, for example, had acorns, but I didn't actually want acorns.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，如果你，比如说，有橡果，但我其实并不想要橡果。

sentences.en: I wanted pots, for example, and I wanted to trade my fish for pots and all you had to offer
sentences.zh: 比方说我想要锅，我想用我的鱼去换锅，而你唯一能提供给

sentences.en: me was acorns, then essentially we couldn't negotiate.
sentences.zh: 我的却是橡果，那么本质上我们就无法进行协商。

sentences.en: And economists sometimes have a term for this.
sentences.zh: 经济学家有时会用一个术语来描述这一点。

sentences.en: They say that barter requires something called a double coincidence of wands.
sentences.zh: 他们说，以物易物需要一种叫做“欲望的双重巧合”的东西。

sentences.en: What is that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: The double coincidence of wands essentially means that in that moment, I've got what you
sentences.zh: 欲望的双重巧合本质上意味着，在那个时刻，我有你

sentences.en: need, you've got what I need.
sentences.zh: 需要的东西，你也有我需要的东西。

sentences.en: There's a coincidence of our needs in the instance.
sentences.zh: 在那个瞬间，我们的需求巧合地契合了。

sentences.en: And that rarely happens, right?
sentences.zh: 而这种情况很少发生，对吧？

sentences.en: So the idea here is that humans wizard up this kind of third thing, money, this magical
sentences.zh: 所以这里的想法是，人类凭空变出了第三种东西——货币，这种神奇的

sentences.en: substance that can put all things on one scale of value and use that as sort of their
sentences.zh: 物质可以把所有东西放在一个价值天平上，然后把它当作一种

sentences.en: measuring stick then to make these kinds of transactions.
sentences.zh: 衡量标准，来进行这类交易。

sentences.en: So there's a problem with the story and the problem is that it runs into some facts.
sentences.zh: 所以这个故事有个问题，问题在于它与一些事实相悖。

sentences.en: I'm wondering if you can tell me about the work that you and other anthropologists have
sentences.zh: 我想知道你能否跟我谈谈你和其他人类学家所做的工作，

sentences.en: done, for example, in the highlands of New Guinea that caught into question this origin
sentences.zh: 例如在新几内亚高地的工作，这些工作对这个起源

sentences.en: story.
sentences.zh: 故事提出了质疑。

sentences.en: The problem is that when we look around the world and in the historical and archaeological
sentences.zh: 问题是，当我们环顾世界，并在历史和考古

sentences.en: record for instances of this kind of direct barter, unfortunately, we don't find it.
sentences.zh: 记录中寻找这种直接以物易物的实例时，不幸的是，我们找不到。

sentences.en: What we find instead really are systems where people are taking some kind of object, let's
sentences.zh: 我们真正找到的往往是这样一些系统：人们拿着某种物品——

sentences.en: take a kind of a big shell valuable in the highlands of New Guinea, and using it to mark
sentences.zh: 比如说新几内亚高地的一种大型贝壳贵重物品——并用它来标记

sentences.en: relationships.
sentences.zh: 人际关系。

sentences.en: They're using it to mark relationships among people, among kin, that serve as a kind of indicator
sentences.zh: 他们用它来标记人与人之间、亲属之间的关系，这可以作为

sentences.en: of enduring obligations that people have to one another.
sentences.zh: 人们彼此之间承担的持久义务的一种指标。

sentences.en: It's kind of like an open-ended IOU, right?
sentences.zh: 这有点像一张没有规定最终期限的借条，对吧？

sentences.en: If I give you this big shell thing, then that implies for us, but also for everyone around
sentences.zh: 如果我把这个巨大的贝壳交给你，那么对我们而言，同时也对我们周围的

sentences.en: us, that we have a bond.
sentences.zh: 所有人而言，这就意味着我们之间有了纽带。

sentences.en: We have a relationship that will essentially allow us to have a flow of goods between each
sentences.zh: 我们建立了一种关系，从本质上讲，它将允许我们在余生中

sentences.en: other and between our families for the rest of our lives, essentially.
sentences.zh: 在我们之间以及我们的家庭之间实现货物流通。

sentences.en: So it's not so much that I'm giving you this shell so that you give me some pigs.
sentences.zh: 所以，与其说我给你这个贝壳是为了让你给我一些猪，

sentences.en: It's I'm giving you this shell so as to say, hey, someday I'm going to need some pigs.
sentences.zh: 不如说我给你这个贝壳是在表达：嘿，总有一天我会需要一些猪。

sentences.en: Some other day, I might need your help in the field.
sentences.zh: 在未来的某一天，我可能需要在田地里得到你的帮助。

sentences.en: Some other day, you might need me to help you out with something.
sentences.zh: 在未来的某一天，你可能需要我帮你的忙。

sentences.en: This shell kind of marks that relationship.
sentences.zh: 这个贝壳标志着这种关系。

sentences.en: It signifies to everyone around us that we have these ties of enduring obligation and
sentences.zh: 它向我们周围的所有人表明，我们拥有这种持久的义务和

sentences.en: responsibility.
sentences.zh: 责任纽带。

sentences.en: So in other words, it's not about a transaction, at least not in an immediate sense.
sentences.zh: 所以换句话说，这无关乎交易，至少在即时意义上不是。

sentences.en: It's about a transaction that perhaps unfolds over time, more to do with obligation.
sentences.zh: 它关乎一种或许随着时间推移而展开的交易，更多的是关于义务。

sentences.en: My son is marrying your daughter.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子要娶你的女儿。

sentences.en: I'm giving you this precious necklace that I have.
sentences.zh: 我把这条我珍藏的项链送给你。

sentences.en: And my expectation is over the next 20 years, our families are going to help one another
sentences.zh: 我的期望是，在接下来的20年里，我们的两家人将会在

sentences.en: in all kinds of ways.
sentences.zh: 方方面面互相帮助。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's really a memory device to indicate an ongoing, enduring relationship, an ongoing
sentences.zh: 它实际上是一个记忆装置，用来标示一种持续的、持久的关系，以及

sentences.en: set of obligations.
sentences.zh: 一系列持续的义务。

sentences.en: And is some of this connected with the more basic idea, if you will, of just gift giving?
sentences.zh: 这是否与送礼这一更基础的想法（如果你愿意这么说的话）有某种联系？

sentences.en: When you think about gifts, part of what we're doing when I'm giving you a gift, and presumably
sentences.zh: 当你想到礼物时，我送你礼物时所做的事情的一部分——

sentences.en: this is true for people all over the world in different cultures, the gift is partly my
sentences.zh: 据推测，世界各地不同文化中的人都是如此——送礼在某种程度上是我在

sentences.en: telling you, here's something nice for you.
sentences.zh: 告诉你，这是送给你的好东西。

sentences.en: But it also binds us in some kind of relationship that says, down the line, you know, it's not
sentences.zh: 但它也将我们绑定在某种关系中，意味着在未来，你知道的，虽然没有明说，

sentences.en: explicit, but there's some implicit understanding that you're going to do something nice for
sentences.zh: 但有一种隐含的默契，即在将来的某个时候，你也会为我

sentences.en: me down the road.
sentences.zh: 做一些好事。

sentences.en: This is exactly how it works.
sentences.zh: 这正是它的运作方式。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the early anthropologist Marcel Mose wrote about this quite explicitly, saying that in
sentences.zh: 早期人类学家马塞尔·莫斯对这一点进行了非常明确的论述，他说，

sentences.en: the gift, there's the obligation to give, there's the obligation to receive, but then
sentences.zh: 在礼物中，既有给予的义务，也有接受的义务，但同时

sentences.en: also the obligation to reciprocate.
sentences.zh: 还有回报的义务。

sentences.en: This obligation to reciprocate can be seen across human societies and across time.
sentences.zh: 这种回报的义务可以在整个人类社会和漫长的时间跨度中看到。

sentences.en: Some years ago, Bill stumbled on another interesting example of this.
sentences.zh: 几年前，比尔偶然发现了另一个有趣的例子。

sentences.en: He was in Washington, D.C., visiting a colleague who worked at the Smithsonian.
sentences.zh: 当时他在华盛顿特区，拜访一位在史密森尼学会工作的同事。

sentences.en: She curated the museum's collections that relate to the history of money.
sentences.zh: 她负责管理博物馆中与货币历史相关的藏品。

sentences.en: Bill was with her inside a vault.
sentences.zh: 比尔和她一起在一个金库里。

sentences.en: And there's an area in the vault in a kind of long closet, and she and her interns call
sentences.zh: 金库里有一个区域，在一个类似长衣柜的地方，她和她的实习生们

sentences.en: it Narnia because it's sort of like the wardrobe in Narnia.
sentences.zh: 把它叫做纳尼亚，因为它有点像《纳尼亚传奇》里的衣柜。

sentences.en: You go in and it goes on and on and on forever.
sentences.zh: 你走进去，它就会无休无止地延伸下去。

sentences.en: Inside this Narnia, there are boxes upon boxes of uncatalogued artifacts.
sentences.zh: 在这个纳尼亚魔幻世界里，藏着一箱又一箱未编目的文物。

sentences.en: So I was there once with her and she said to me, do you want to go to Narnia?
sentences.zh: 所以有一次我和她一起去那儿，她对我说，你想去纳尼亚吗？

sentences.en: And I said, sure.
sentences.zh: 我说，当然。

sentences.en: So we go in, pull out a box at random, bring it out.
sentences.zh: 于是我们走进去，随机抽出一个箱子，把它拿出来。

sentences.en: She opens the box and there's a ton of these clay tablets covered in cuneiform.
sentences.zh: 她打开箱子，里面有大量刻有楔形文字的泥板。

sentences.en: And there's a sort of moment where both of us back away from the box, you know, and I'm
sentences.zh: 当时我们俩都有点从箱子旁退缩的意思，你知道的，我当时

sentences.en: like, uh-oh, don't touch anything.
sentences.zh: 心里想，哎呀，别碰任何东西。

sentences.en: Don't break anything.
sentences.zh: 别打破任何东西。

sentences.en: Don't breathe.
sentences.zh: 连呼吸都要小心。

sentences.en: The clay tablets that they pulled out of the box were used 5,000 years ago in ancient Mesopotamia.
sentences.zh: 他们从箱子里拿出来的泥板是五千年前古代美索不达米亚人使用的。

sentences.en: They were used to keep records of obligations.
sentences.zh: 它们被用来记录各种契约和债务。

sentences.en: When people lived in small groups, monitoring obligations was easy.
sentences.zh: 当人们生活在小群体中时，监督债务很容易。

sentences.en: I just remembered what you had said and done, and you remembered what I had said and done.

sentences.zh: 我们进行了一场广泛的交流，讨论了美国的女性历史，

sentences.en: about the history of slavery and emancipation and the civil rights movement,
sentences.zh: 关于奴隶制、废奴运动以及民权运动的历史，

sentences.en: and about the kinds of things that you could do on a banknote,
sentences.zh: 以及你可以在钞票上做哪些事情，

sentences.en: the kinds of stories that you could tell on the money about the nation,
sentences.zh: 你可以在钱上讲述关于这个国家的哪些故事，

sentences.en: and the ways those stories could make people feel included in the nation in a new way.
sentences.zh: 以及这些故事如何能让人们以一种全新的方式感受到自己是国家的一员。

sentences.en: Again, this was happening in 2015.
sentences.zh: 再强调一次，这是在2015年发生的。

sentences.en: That was the same year that the musical Hamilton debuted on Broadway.
sentences.zh: 那也是音乐剧《汉密尔顿》在百老汇首演的同一年。

sentences.en: His financial system is a work of genius.
sentences.zh: 他的金融系统简直是天才之作。

sentences.en: I couldn't undo it if I tried.
sentences.zh: 就算我想撤销它也无能为力。

sentences.en: And it reminded everyone of the role that Alexander Hamilton played
sentences.zh: 这让每个人都想起了亚历山大·汉密尔顿所扮演的角色

sentences.en: in establishing our banking system.
sentences.zh: 在建立我们银行系统过程中的作用。

sentences.en: The figure on the 10 currently is Alexander Hamilton,
sentences.zh: 目前10美元纸币上的人物是亚历山大·汉密尔顿，

sentences.en: and we thought maybe we want to keep him.
sentences.zh: 我们当时想，也许我们应该保留他。

sentences.en: So Bill and the group decide that instead of redesigning the $10 bill,
sentences.zh: 于是比尔和这个团队决定，与其重新设计10美元纸币，

sentences.en: they should update the 20.
sentences.zh: 不如更新20美元纸币。

sentences.en: Since the 20 is a more ubiquitous banknote,
sentences.zh: 由于20美元面值更普及，

sentences.en: it's the one that comes out of all the ATMs,
sentences.zh: 它是所有自动取款机里吐出的钞票，

sentences.en: it's much more common in people's daily transactions than the 10.
sentences.zh: 在人们日常交易中，它比10美元常见得多。

sentences.en: The image of Andrew Jackson, the seventh president of the United States,
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·杰克逊——美国第七任总统的肖像，

sentences.en: has been on the $20 bill since 1928.
sentences.zh: 自1928年以来就一直印在20美元纸币上。

sentences.en: Jackson's tenure was marked by the signing of the Indian Removal Act,
sentences.zh: 杰克逊的任期以签署《印第安人迁移法案》为标志，

sentences.en: which resulted in the deaths of thousands of indigenous people.
sentences.zh: 该法案导致了数千名原住民的死亡。

sentences.en: Bill and other members of the group in Washington
sentences.zh: 比尔和华盛顿团队的其他成员

sentences.en: felt a woman should take Jackson's place.
sentences.zh: 认为应该由一位女性来取代杰克逊的位置。

sentences.en: They gravitated toward a hero of the Underground Railroad.
sentences.zh: 他们不约而同地倾向于地下铁路的一位英雄。

sentences.en: There was really strong consensus around Harriet Tubman,
sentences.zh: 大家对哈莉特·塔布曼形成了非常强烈的共识，

sentences.en: in part because having her on the bill would help to sort of,
sentences.zh: 部分原因是因为让她的头像上钞票有助于某种程度上，

sentences.en: you know, sketch and then complete a story arc about American society,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，勾勒并完成一个关于美国社会的故事弧线，

sentences.en: about increasing the franchise, about emancipation,
sentences.zh: 关于选举权的扩大，关于废奴，

sentences.en: about the civil rights movement.
sentences.zh: 关于民权运动。

sentences.en: And one of the things that got all of us very excited was when the then treasurer of the United States,
sentences.zh: 让我们所有人感到非常兴奋的一件事是，时任美国财政部长，

sentences.en: Rosie Rios, passed around her favorite banknote, which is the $2 bill.
sentences.zh: 罗斯·里奥斯（Rosie Rios）拿出了她最喜欢的纸币，也就是2美元纸币。

sentences.en: And she passed it around for us to look at.
sentences.zh: 她把它传阅开来让我们观看。

sentences.en: And she's like, take a look at the back.
sentences.zh: 她说，看看背面。

sentences.en: We look at the back.
sentences.zh: 我们看着背面。

sentences.en: Unlike all of the other American banknotes, the $2 bill has a scene.
sentences.zh: 与其他所有美国纸币不同，2美元纸币上有一个场景。

sentences.en: It has people standing together signing the Declaration of Independence.
sentences.zh: 上面有人们站在一起签署《独立宣言》的画面。

sentences.en: And she said, you know, what can you do if you activate the back of the note with people?
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道的，如果你用人物来激活钞票的背面，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: And then, you know, our minds kind of went racing around that idea of, you know,
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，我们的思绪开始围绕这个想法飞速运转，你知道的，

sentences.en: you could have the $5 bill, keep Lincoln on the front, keep the Lincoln Memorial on the back,
sentences.zh: 你可以保留5美元纸币正面林肯的头像，保留背面林肯纪念堂的图案，

sentences.en: but populate it with the civil rights march and a tiny little Martin Luther King giving his
sentences.zh: 但在上面填满民权游行队伍，以及一个小小的马丁·路德·金在发表

sentences.en: I Have a Dream speech or something like that.
sentences.zh: 《我有一个梦想》演讲之类的场景。

sentences.en: There was a point where I think we got a little too excited and too creative.
sentences.zh: 当时我觉得我们的确有点过于兴奋、过于有创意了。

sentences.en: And the treasurer said, you know, bear in mind, there's a limited amount of real estate on this thing.
sentences.zh: 财政部长说，记住，这上面的空间是有限的。

sentences.en: And there's only so much that designers can do.
sentences.zh: 设计师能做的事情也是有限的。

sentences.en: And don't forget that all of the counterfeit detection stuff has to go in there, too.
sentences.zh: 别忘了所有的防伪技术也必须塞进去。

sentences.en: So, like, there are a few moments where she's like, okay, settle down, people.
sentences.zh: 所以，有那么几个时刻她会说，好了，大家冷静一下。

sentences.en: Too creative.
sentences.zh: 太有创意了。

sentences.en: We're not going to have a graphic novel on the banknote.
sentences.zh: 我们可不在钞票上搞连环画小说。

sentences.en: But that's kind of really where our minds went because we started thinking about all of the stories
sentences.zh: 但我们的思绪确实飘到了那个方向，因为我们开始思考所有这些故事，

sentences.en: that you can tell on this thing that really is still one of the most ubiquitous forms of mass media
sentences.zh: 你可以在这张依然是美国最普及的大众媒介之一的纸币上讲述这些故事，

sentences.en: in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国。

sentences.en: The announcement about the $20 bill redesign was made in April 2016.
sentences.zh: 关于20美元纸币重新设计的公告于2016年4月发布。

sentences.en: Harriet Tubman, who helped more than 300 slaves find freedom through the Underground Railroad,
sentences.zh: 哈莉特·塔布曼曾通过地下铁路帮助300多名奴隶获得自由，

sentences.en: will be the new face of the $20 bill.
sentences.zh: 她将成为20美元纸币的新面孔。

sentences.en: Tubman will be the first woman featured on the front of U.S.
sentences.zh: 塔布曼将成为第一位出现在美国货币正面

sentences.en: currency.
sentences.zh: 的女性。

sentences.en: Andrew Jackson would remain on one side of the bill, and Harriet Tubman would be on the other.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·杰克逊将保留在纸币的一侧，而哈莉特·塔布曼将在另一侧。

sentences.en: The rebranding was announced during President Barack Obama's final year in office.
sentences.zh: 这一品牌重塑计划是在贝拉克·奥巴马总统任期的最后一年宣布的。

sentences.en: Then-presidential candidate Donald Trump called the decision pure political correctness.
sentences.zh: 当时的总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普称这一决定纯粹是政治正确。

sentences.en: He was asked about the redesign on NBC's Today Show.
sentences.zh: 他在美国全国广播公司（NBC）的《今日秀》节目中被问及重新设计一事。

sentences.en: I think Harriet Tubman is fantastic.
sentences.zh: 我认为哈莉特·塔布曼非常棒。

sentences.en: I would love to leave Andrew Jackson and see if we can maybe come up with another denomination.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意保留安德鲁·杰克逊，并看看我们是否可以考虑发行另一种面额的货币。

sentences.en: Maybe we do the $2 bill.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以用2美元面值。

sentences.en: Less than a year after the redesign was announced, Donald Trump became president.
sentences.zh: 在宣布重新设计不到一年后，唐纳德·特朗普当选总统。

sentences.en: In the Oval Office, he hung a portrait of his favorite predecessor.
sentences.zh: 在椭圆形办公室里，他挂了一幅自己最喜欢的前任的肖像画。

sentences.en: It was Andrew Jackson.
sentences.zh: 那是安德鲁·杰克逊。

sentences.en: Andrew Jackson is keeping his place on the $20 bill for now.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·杰克逊目前将继续保留在20美元纸币上。

sentences.en: That's according to Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin, whose department oversees the design of currency.
sentences.zh: 这是财政部长史蒂芬·姆努钦透露的，他的部门负责货币的设计。

sentences.en: The Trump administration tabled the redesign just months before the bill was expected to be released.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府在预计发行该纸币的前几个月搁置了重新设计计划。

sentences.en: The ultimate decision on the redesign will most likely be another secretary's down the road.
sentences.zh: 关于重新设计的最终决定很可能要留给未来的另一位财政部长去做了。

sentences.en: So it seems like the project is on hold right now, and we'll see how things develop.
sentences.zh: 所以这个项目目前似乎处于搁置状态，我们要看看事情会如何发展。

sentences.en: Regardless, the notes will have to be redesigned because of the overriding reason for which they're redesigned, which is anti-counterfeiting.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这些纸币都必须重新设计，因为重新设计的最根本原因就是防伪。

sentences.en: So we'll see what happens.
sentences.zh: 所以我们拭目以待吧。

sentences.en: The faces and scenes we see on our money communicate our values as a nation.
sentences.zh: 我们钱上看到的头像和场景传达了我们作为国家的价值观。

sentences.en: And the way we use that money communicates something about us as individuals.
sentences.zh: 而我们使用这些钱的方式则传达了我们作为个体的某种特质。

sentences.en: When I give you money, I'm not just giving you a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 当我给你钱时，我给你的不仅仅是一张纸。

sentences.en: I'm giving you my word, my bond.
sentences.zh: 我给你的我的诺言，我的契约。

sentences.en: Society is a thing of ongoing, continuous relationships and unsettled debts, right?
sentences.zh: 社会是由持续不断的关系和未了结的债务构成的，对吧？

sentences.en: The settling and unsettling of debts on and on and on and on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 债务的了结与未了结，没完没了，一直持续下去。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续关注我们。

sentences.en: Some years ago, economist Joel Wolfogel wrote a paper.
sentences.zh: 多年前，经济学家乔尔·沃尔福格尔写了一篇论文。

sentences.en: It was titled The Deadweight Loss of Christmas.
sentences.zh: 题为《圣诞节的无谓损失》。

sentences.en: He argued that it made no sense for me to give you gifts that you don't like
sentences.zh: 他认为，我送你你不喜欢的礼物，

sentences.en: and for you to give me gifts that I don't like.
sentences.zh: 而你送我我不喜欢的礼物，这毫无意义。

sentences.en: We would both be better off keeping our money and spending it on the things we do like.
sentences.zh: 我们俩把钱留着花在自己真正喜欢的东西上会更好。

sentences.en: Bill has many disputes with how economists see the world of money.
sentences.zh: 比尔对经济学家看待金钱世界的方式有很多异议。

sentences.en: Joel Wolfogel's argument might be ground zero.
sentences.zh: 乔尔·沃尔福格尔的论点可能是这一切的起点。

sentences.en: I think one of the things that economists are always imagining is that the end of transactions
sentences.zh: 我认为经济学家们总是想象的一点是，交易的终点

sentences.en: is to have them settled, right?
sentences.zh: 就是把账结清，对吧？

sentences.en: That we enter a relationship of debt and then we want to settle that debt.
sentences.zh: 我们进入了一种债务关系，然后我们想要了结这种债务。

sentences.en: So you hand me over something at the store and I give you money at the till and then it's over
sentences.zh: 所以在店里你递给我一件东西，我在收银台付给你钱，然后就结束了

sentences.en: and then we go our separate ways.
sentences.zh: 接着我们各奔东西。

sentences.en: They love that kind of vision of the frictionless market where parties come to the market anonymously
sentences.zh: 他们非常喜欢那种无摩擦市场的愿景：各方匿名进入市场，

sentences.en: and money is the thing that mediates their relationship so that then they continue to go on anonymously.
sentences.zh: 而金钱则是介导他们关系的媒介，之后他们继续保持匿名状态。

sentences.en: The problem is that if you imagine a world where all debts are settled, then what is that world?
sentences.zh: 问题是，如果你想象一个所有债务都已了结的世界，那会是一个什么样的世界？

sentences.en: That's a world then of no more relationships, of no more mutuality, of no more obligation.
sentences.zh: 那将是一个没有关系、没有互惠、没有义务的世界。

sentences.en: Society is not a society of settled debts.
sentences.zh: 社会并非一个债务已了结的社会。

sentences.en: Society is a thing of ongoing continuous relationships and unsettled debts, right?
sentences.zh: 社会是由持续不断的关系和未了结的债务构成的，对吧？

sentences.en: The settling and unsettling of debts on and on and on and on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 债务的了结与未了结，没完没了，一直持续下去。

sentences.en: There's no moment where it ends or at least if there was a moment where it ended,
sentences.zh: 没有哪个时刻它会终结，或者至少说，如果真有终结的那一刻，

sentences.en: we'd all just be alone in bunkers hiding, doing nothing.
sentences.zh: 我们大家就只能独自躲在掩体里，什么也不做了。

sentences.en: So I'm wondering if this is connected to some very interesting phenomena that we see,
sentences.zh: 所以我在想，这是否与我们看到的某个非常有趣的现象有关，

sentences.en: which is that even after coming up with this remarkable invention, money,
sentences.zh: 那就是，即使在发明了金钱这个了不起的工具之后，

sentences.en: we've also come up with lots of ways to make money inefficient and difficult to use.
sentences.zh: 我们也想出了很多方法让金钱变得低效且难以使用。

sentences.en: So we give our friends gift cards to restaurants that limit in some ways how they can use the money.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们送给朋友餐厅礼品卡，在某种程度上限制了他们使用这笔钱的方式。

sentences.en: In some ways it would be easier just to give them cash and they could use it at the restaurant
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，直接给他们现金会更简单，他们可以在那家餐厅花掉

sentences.en: or not use it at the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 或者不在那家餐厅花掉。

sentences.en: What do these inefficient forms of money tell us about the role that money plays in personal relationships?
sentences.zh: 这些低效的货币形式向我们传达了关于金钱在个人关系中扮演什么角色的信息？

sentences.en: Yeah, I love this kind of stuff because it really shows you that money is never purely fungible, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，我很喜欢这类话题，因为它真的向你展示了金钱从来都不是纯粹同质可替代的，对吧？

sentences.en: We're continuously putting boundaries around different pots of money.
sentences.zh: 我们不断地在不同的资金池周围划定界限。

sentences.en: And those boundaries are often moral boundaries.
sentences.zh: 而这些界限往往是道德界限。

sentences.en: They signify a moral or ethical or relational stance that we want to take with respect to one another.
sentences.zh: 它们象征着我们希望在彼此关系中采取的一种道德、伦理或关系的立场。

sentences.en: And this kind of earmarking of money for special purposes,
sentences.zh: 这种为特定目的给金钱贴标签的行为，

sentences.en: this kind of sequestering of some money,
sentences.zh: 这种将部分资金隔离的行为，

sentences.en: taking it out of circulation and keeping it in a special place for only a special purpose,
sentences.zh: 将其移出流通领域并保存在特殊地方仅用于特殊目的，

sentences.en: really does help us make the stuff of social life,
sentences.zh: 确实有助于我们构建社会生活的织体，

sentences.en: helps us stitch ourselves together and bind us to one another
sentences.zh: 帮助我们将彼此缝合在一起，并将我们相互绑定，

sentences.en: in ways that far exceed the imagination of money as just a neutral medium of exchange.
sentences.zh: 其方式远超将金钱视为纯粹中立交换媒介的想象。

sentences.en: The tensions between these two models of money,
sentences.zh: 这两种货币模型之间的张力，

sentences.en: between the economist model and the anthropologist model,
sentences.zh: 即经济学家模型与人类学家模型之间的张力，

sentences.en: exist within each of us.
sentences.zh: 存在于我们每个人的内心深处。

sentences.en: We couldn't function as economic actors without the capacity to think of money
sentences.zh: 如果没有将金钱视为匿名交换的中立形式的能力，

sentences.en: as a neutral form of anonymous exchange.
sentences.zh: 我们就无法作为经济行动者运转。

sentences.en: Of course, all of us also intuitively understand how debts and obligations work,
sentences.zh: 当然，我们所有人也都直观地理解债务和义务是如何运作的，

sentences.en: and we sometimes become uncomfortable when these two models collide with one another.
sentences.zh: 当这两种模型发生冲突时，我们有时会感到不自在。

sentences.en: For example, we have struggled for decades with the challenge of time-consuming
sentences.zh: 例如，几十年来，我们一直在与那些耗时且困难的活动带来的挑战作斗争，

sentences.en: and difficult activities like parenting or domestic work or caring for aging parents.
sentences.zh: 比如育儿、家务劳动或照顾年迈的父母。

sentences.en: Should we think of these things as jobs, put a dollar figure on them,
sentences.zh: 我们应该把这些事情视为工作，给它们贴上美元标签，

sentences.en: or should some things exist outside the sphere of money?
sentences.zh: 还是说有些事情应该存在于金钱领域之外？

sentences.en: This is kind of a paradox of modern subjects in contemporary Western societies,
sentences.zh: 这可以说是当代西方社会中现代人的一个悖论，

sentences.en: is that we think of ourselves as individuals first and members of relationships second,
sentences.zh: 那就是我们首先认为自己是独立的个体，其次才是社会关系的成员，

sentences.en: even though, of course, it's only through relationships that we get formed, right?
sentences.zh: 尽管当然，我们只有通过关系才能被塑造，对吧？

sentences.en: I wouldn't exist if it were not for a relationship between my parents,
sentences.zh: 如果没有我父母之间的关系，我就不会存在，

sentences.en: and I wouldn't be able to be speaking to you now
sentences.zh: 如果我身边没有一个教我语言的网络，

sentences.en: if there weren't a network of folks around me who taught me language, right?
sentences.zh: 我就无法像现在这样跟你说话，对吧？

sentences.en: Who taught me how to be in the world and how to be a person that makes connections.
sentences.zh: 是他们教我在世间如何为人，如何建立联系。

sentences.en: And yet, because we have this kind of ideology that we are each a new person,
sentences.zh: 然而，由于我们怀有一种意识形态，认为我们每个人都是全新的人，

sentences.en: and we each stand alone, we are our own autonomous agent,
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都孤立存在，是独立的自主行动者，

sentences.en: we forget about those relationships.
sentences.zh: 我们便忽视了这些关系。

sentences.en: And when those things are brought forward, we feel sometimes a little eww about them, right?
sentences.zh: 而当这些事情被提出来时，我们有时会对它们感到有点排斥，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't want to be that.
sentences.zh: 我才不要成为那样的人。

sentences.en: I don't want to have that connection.
sentences.zh: 我不想建立那种联系。

sentences.en: I don't want to be tied to you.
sentences.zh: 我不想被你绑在一起。

sentences.en: Bill, I understand that you have a somewhat unusual living arrangement,
sentences.zh: 比尔，我理解你的生活方式有点不同寻常，

sentences.en: and I'm wondering if you can tell me a little bit about it,
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否能跟我多讲讲，

sentences.en: and then talk about some of the relationships that are embedded in your housing.
sentences.zh: 然后再聊聊你这种住房状况中所包含的一些人际关系。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Okay, disclaimer.
sentences.zh: 好的，先声明一下。

sentences.en: I am not a hippie, and we are not a tribe,
sentences.zh: 我不是嬉皮士，我们也不是什么部族，

sentences.en: but I live with my partner and another married couple.
sentences.zh: 但我跟我的伴侣还有另一对已婚夫妇住在一起。

sentences.en: There are four of us together, and the other couple has a young son.
sentences.zh: 我们一共四个人，另一对夫妇有一个小男孩。

sentences.en: And before their child was born, we became very close friends.
sentences.zh: 在他们的孩子出生之前，我们就成了非常要好的朋友。

sentences.en: We were living a few blocks away from each other.
sentences.zh: 我们当时住在几个街区之外。

sentences.en: We ended up kind of eating at each other's houses every night,
sentences.zh: 结果我们基本上每天都在对方家里吃饭，

sentences.en: you know, a kind of close little network of friends.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是一个关系紧密的小朋友圈。

sentences.en: And I live in Southern California.
sentences.zh: 我住在南加州。

sentences.en: It's very expensive.
sentences.zh: 那里物价非常高。

sentences.en: We are four professionals,
sentences.zh: 我们四个都是专业人士，

sentences.en: but even with four professional salaries,
sentences.zh: 但即使有四份专业人士的薪水，

sentences.en: we felt that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们还是觉得，你知道的，

sentences.en: we couldn't necessarily have the kind of house that we wanted.
sentences.zh: 我们不一定能买得起自己想要的房子。

sentences.en: So we thought, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我们想，

sentences.en: we're kind of eating together all the time anyway
sentences.zh: 反正我们平时也是总是在一起吃饭

sentences.en: and doing everything together.
sentences.zh: 而且什么事都在一起做。

sentences.en: Let's buy a house together.
sentences.zh: 不如一起买套房子吧。

sentences.en: And, you know, sometimes you just sort of make these decisions,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有时候你做这些决定时，

sentences.en: and you don't know if they're good or bad or what.
sentences.zh: 你根本不知道它们是好是坏，或者会怎么样。

sentences.en: But we jumped in.
sentences.zh: 但我们还是直接行动了。

sentences.en: We spent, you know, a year looking for a place.
sentences.zh: 我们花了整整一年时间找房子。

sentences.en: It's sort of two flats, but with an interior staircase.
sentences.zh: 那基本上是两套公寓，但内部有楼梯相连。

sentences.en: So it feels more like one big house.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉更像是一栋大房子。

sentences.en: They gave birth to their son, Carter.
sentences.zh: 他们生下了儿子卡特。

sentences.en: And we all moved in together.
sentences.zh: 然后我们所有人都搬到了一起。

sentences.en: And we've been living together now for, I guess, 13 years, maybe more.
sentences.zh: 到现在我们大概已经一起生活了13年，可能还不止。

sentences.en: And, you know, as someone who sort of studies money and economic relationships,
sentences.zh: 而且，作为一个研究金钱和经济关系的人，

sentences.en: if I take a step back and look at my own situation,
sentences.zh: 如果我退一步看看我自己的处境，

sentences.en: it's kind of interesting because we don't actually have
sentences.zh: 这其实挺有意思的，因为我们实际上并没有

sentences.en: any kind of internal system of accounting.
sentences.zh: 任何内部的记账系统。

sentences.en: We own the house as tenants in common.
sentences.zh: 我们以共同共有（共同租户）的形式拥有这栋房子。

sentences.en: We share the mortgage.
sentences.zh: 我们共同承担按揭贷款。

sentences.en: So we split the mortgage down the middle.
sentences.zh: 所以我们对半平分房贷。

sentences.en: At tax time, we split the interest down the middle for filing our taxes.
sentences.zh: 到报税季时，为了报税，我们也是对半平分利息。

sentences.en: But other than that,
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，

sentences.en: we're basically sharing all of our expenses
sentences.zh: 我们基本上是共享所有的开销，

sentences.en: and just kind of living that way.
sentences.zh: 就以这种方式生活着。

sentences.en: There's no mental accounting, really.
sentences.zh: 真的没有什么心理上的记账。

sentences.en: There's no, you know,
sentences.zh: 没有什么，你知道的，

sentences.en: I paid for the groceries this week, so you do it next week.
sentences.zh: 这周我付了杂货费，所以下周你来付这种事。

sentences.en: We're just comfortable doing that
sentences.zh: 我们这样过得很自在，

sentences.en: and operating as a kind of larger economic unit.
sentences.zh: 并且作为一个更大的经济整体在运转。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I mean, we really are kind of living
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我的意思是，我们确实是在

sentences.en: in a sort of alternative economic arrangement
sentences.zh: 一种另类的经济安排中生活，

sentences.en: that's based on these, you know, close,
sentences.zh: 这种安排建立在这些，你知道的，紧密的、

sentences.en: I think you could almost call them kin relationships
sentences.zh: 我想你甚至可以称之为亲属关系的联系之上，

sentences.en: that we've established together.
sentences.zh: 这是我们共同建立的。

sentences.en: And in many ways, like the house is the symbol of those relationships, right?
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，比如这栋房子就是这些关系的象征，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, the house is our shell valuable, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这栋房子就是我们的“贝壳货币”（有价值的交换物），对吧？

sentences.en: It's the thing that signifies that connection.
sentences.zh: 它是这种连接的标志。

sentences.en: So what's so interesting about this arrangement is,
sentences.zh: 所以这种安排最有趣的地方在于，

sentences.en: in some ways, it speaks to what you said some time ago
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，它呼应了你前段时间说过的话，

sentences.en: about the difference between the way economists want to think about transactions
sentences.zh: 关于经济学家看待交易的方式与

sentences.en: and the way that you're describing them,
sentences.zh: 你所描述的方式之间的区别，

sentences.en: which is that if you want to live in a world where the transaction is over,
sentences.zh: 也就是说，如果你想生活在一个交易就此结束的世界里，

sentences.en: you know, you give me something, I pay you something,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你给我一样东西，我付你一样东西，

sentences.en: we shake hands, we never see each other again.
sentences.zh: 我们握手言和，再也不见。

sentences.en: That is not the system that you have set up for your housing, right?
sentences.zh: 这并不是你为自己的住房所建立的系统，对吧？

sentences.en: Because the system that you've set up is a system, in some ways,
sentences.zh: 因为你建立的系统，从某种程度上说，是一个

sentences.en: of indefinite debts and obligations
sentences.zh: 充满无限债务和义务的系统，

sentences.en: that are constantly being created and repaid.
sentences.zh: 这些债务和义务在不断地产生和偿还。

sentences.en: You're constantly engaged in gift-giving, gift-taking,
sentences.zh: 你们不断地在送礼和收礼，

sentences.en: but that binds you, in some ways, in a web of obligations
sentences.zh: 但这从某种程度上将你们绑定在了一个义务之网中，

sentences.en: that I'm hearing you say, in some ways, has worked very well for you.
sentences.zh: 照我听来，这种方式在很多方面对你们非常管用。

sentences.en: It's worked very well.
sentences.zh: 非常管用。

sentences.en: You know, we actually had an anthropologist want to come live with us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，实际上曾有一位人类学家想搬来和我们一起住。

sentences.en: I said no.
sentences.zh: 我拒绝了。

sentences.en: So, she's like, I would really love to study this.
sentences.zh: 所以，她当时说，我真的很想研究这个。

sentences.en: This is fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这太迷人了。

sentences.en: No, you can't live in our house.
sentences.zh: 我说，不行，你不能住在我们家。

sentences.en: So, in other words, the anthropologist doesn't like it
sentences.zh: 所以，换句话说，这位人类学家并不喜欢

sentences.en: when other anthropologists come in and want to study the first anthropologiSt.
sentences.zh: 其他人类学家跑来研究第一位人类学家。

sentences.en: The anthropologist finds it amusing when others want to do so.
sentences.zh: 这位人类学家发现别人想这么做时觉得挺搞笑的。

sentences.en: Bill Maurer is an anthropologist at the University of California, Irvine.
sentences.zh: 比尔·莫雷尔是加州大学尔湾分校的人类学家。

sentences.en: He's the author of How Would You Like to Pay?
sentences.zh: 他是《你想怎么付钱？》（How Would You Like to Pay?）

sentences.en: and other works about the nature and origin of money.
sentences.zh: 以及其他关于金钱本质与起源的著作的作者。

sentences.zh: 比尔，谢谢你今天来到“隐藏的大脑”（Hidden Brain）。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Shankar.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，尚卡尔。

sentences.zh: 我很享受这次访谈。
